scientific_integrity: The analytic sign proof and symbolic transient-generator verification concern the stated finite-state process only; no independent scientific audit or experimental confirmation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the four-transient-state exponential-discovery closure conditioned on one fed scenter and one searching bee.
Zero and extreme abandonment rates may fall outside the validity regime of the velocity-jump-to-Poisson discovery approximation.
No extension to complete-colony hitting times, spatially resolved search or data-based biological policy optimization is claimed.
title: Reentrant optimal abandonment in a two-bee recruitment queue
